predicate: ink density in range, every row and column inked, no isolated ink pixel, every horizontal ink run one of the lengths the alphabet uses, at least 3 bits from every glyph, all codes distinct, no anchor to the alphabet
note: No adversary and no gradients: the generator is an 8-bit Boolean circuit of NAND and AND gates, producing all 26 letters of the alphabet and 230 typeface variants satisfying the style predicate.
